versions.changelog:
Initial release of the “no-black-box” skill.

- Provides a detailed guideline for agents to deliver clear, fully transparent handover explanations after independent work.
- Defines structured documentation for requirement background, implementation, validation results, and unresolved issues.
- Enforces consistent organization, use of real examples, clear sourcing, and evidence (including annotated screenshots).
- Includes criteria for when to use/not use; rules for confidentiality, internal communication, and external sharing.
- Supplies templates, self-checklists, and reference files to support detailed, reusable documentation (single-file HTML or online docs).
- Aims to enable users to thoroughly understand delivered work and confidently communicate it to others.
